title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass
impact: Bypasses authentication entirely allowing an attacker to log in as the administrator without a password.
remediation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) instead of string concatenation for database queries.

title: Reflected XSS
impact: Executes arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser which can be used to steal session cookies or perform actions on their behalf.
remediation: Implement proper output encoding and a strict Content Security Policy (CSP).

title: Stored XSS (Client-side XSS Protection)
impact: Persists malicious code in the database which executes whenever an admin views the user list leading to potential account takeover.
remediation: Validate and sanitize all inputs on the server side and use context-aware escaping when rendering.
